test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is correct regarding the production possibility frontier?

I. It gives the combinations between two goods that can be produced when the resources of the economy are fully utilised.

II. It illustrates the production possibilities of the economy.
solution:
Correct Answer **Both I and II**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Production Possibility Frontier (PPF):**

**Statement 1:**

 
• The **PPF** does indeed illustrate the combinations of **two goods or services** that can be produced when the resources of the economy are **fully and efficiently utilized.**
 
• It shows the trade-off between the production of **one good and the production of another, **assuming all resources are used to their **fullest potential.**

**Statement 2:**

 
• The PPF also illustrates the **production possibilities of the economy.**
 
• It shows the maximum possible output combinations of two goods or services an economy can achieve when all resources are **fully and efficiently employed.**
 
• The **PPF **is typically depicted as a downward-sloping curve, with **one good on each axis.**
 
• Points along the curve represent efficient production levels, while points below the curve indicate **inefficiency **and points above the curve are unattainable with current resources and technology.
